units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 13:2">Sifré Deut. 13</cite> <he>וותיקים כ׳</he> distinguished (of position), bright of intellect; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 13:2">ib.</cite> Num. 92 <he>וכסופים</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:5">Pes. III, 5</cite> (expl. <cite ref="U00776"><he>שיאור</he></cite>) <he>כל שהִכְסִיפוּ פניו כאדם וכ׳</he> a dough the surface of which becomes pale and wrinkled, like (the sight of) a man whose hair (<cite ref="U01679"><he>שַׂעַר</he></cite>) stands up from fright.
Nidd. 47ᵃ משיַכְסִיף ראש וכ׳ when the centre of the oblate portion of the breast begins to be wrinkled; Tosef. ib. VI, 4 משיִכָּסֵף (Nif.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 34b">Sabb. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ התחתון</he> when the lower horizon becomes pale (is no longer red); Y. Ber. I, 2ᵇ bot.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 39a:8">Pes. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>פניו מַכְסִיפִין</he> the leaves look faded (and curled); a. e.

senses.gloss: to deteriorate, fall in value, opp. השביח (cmp. חָסַר).
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 30a:56">Arakh. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>וה׳ ועמד על מנה</he> and fell until it was worth only one Manah.
<cite ref="Ketubot 80b:4">Keth. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תַכְסִיף</he> the soil may deteriorate (through neglect); a. e.

senses.gloss: to put to shame; to frighten, to alarm.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:5">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> (play on <cite ref="K00953"><he>כֶּסֶף</he></cite>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 29:4">I Chr. XXIX, 4</cite>) <he>שהיה מַכְסִיף כל הזהבים</he> it alarmed all gold-workers (emptying their shops); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10:4">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite>; Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ top <he>שהיה מ׳ בעד וכ׳</he> spread alarm among all the shops of &c.
